title: Trivalent-ligand bivalent-receptor aggregation (Yang et al., 2008)
reference: Yang J, Monine MI, Faeder JR, Hlavacek WS (2008). Kinetic Monte Carlo method for rule-based modeling of biochemical networks. Phys Rev E 78:031910. doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.78.031910
notes: Published default parameterization (4200 ligands, 300 receptors; beta = kon2*NR/koff = 0.1, below the sol-gel transition). The only network-free problem in the set: every simulation is an NFsim run, about twenty times the cost of the SSA problems, so the budget and the replicates per evaluation are smaller. Three free parameters; the equilibrium is set by kon1*NL/koff and kon2*NR/koff and the approach to it by koff, so all three are determined.
